causal_findings: J10 was not a localization failure: FastDateFormat.java was the sole trigger-loaded production source and all 768 ER2 planner-front candidates targeted it.
The human repair resolves a nullable context value to its default before cache lookup, then always includes the normalized value in the cache key.
The old code normalized the value only after a cache miss, so a null caller could use a cache key that omitted state later used to construct the value.
The same dataflow-order repair is required in two sibling factory methods.

ER2 v1 can compose existing edits but cannot synthesize a guarded default assignment, hoist it before an earlier use, replace conditional key inclusion by unconditional inclusion, and remove the now-redundant late guard.
claim_boundary: J10 remains a valid fresh blind ER2 negative. Its revealed repair may train ER2 v2 but may never reclassify J10 as a pass.
next_development_change: Add a generic default-before-use/cache-key normalization primitive. Mine a later guarded default assignment for a nullable method parameter, detect an earlier conditional key/update use of that same parameter, hoist the default assignment before the earlier use, make the use unconditional, and remove the redundant late guard. Emit both single-method and coordinated sibling-method variants. Encode no Locale, FastDateFormat, cache name, method, Lang-50, test, issue, commit, or line identity.
